inputs: Fixed standardized covariates and normalized time only; no health-state history
objective: alpha*uncensored event-time NLL +(1-alpha)*event-status/censoring loss; mean over minibatch

screen.ranking: minimum validation score seen through current rung; ties candidate ID

recipes.rule: reuse winning screen configuration for this alpha

refinement.clarification: Two alpha candidates are crossed with the same five new recipes plus each alpha screen winner; fixed balanced design, not exhaustive factorial

confirmation.decision: lowest mean best validation score over three seeds

selection_metric: Mean observed-outcome conditional NLL over landmarks with equal landmark weights; all eligible validation patients; no analytical curves/test MAE
validation_eligibility: recorded duration > landmark; event/censor at landmark excluded
l2_definition: explicit0.5*sum(all learned parameters squared)*coefficient/128; no Adam weight decay
confirmation_fits_reused: Selected configuration seeds42/43/45 reused unchanged for final evaluation
final_test: Original300baseline test patients and original eligible subsets from archived reference files; survival both experiments, both CIFs CR3
resampling: Use saved5000paired patient-bootstrap multiplicities for updated ATLAS-versus-DRSA comparisons
transparency: Motivated by original test findings. No original results/manuscript/export ZIPs overwritten. Tiny original saved-inference discrepancies remain separately documented; do not condition new search on test outputs.
precision: float32; no AMP, TF32 disabled; float64 curve propagation
resume: Last state/model/optimizer/RNG at every epoch; best state saved separately; immutable rung decision JSONs
